dozen.producer_scope: Actual RetainedCompute factory and physical Vulkan device. The observer verifies the embedded module and forwards it unmodified.
dozen.revision_scope: Strict Linux qualification build of sirius_backend and sirius_backend_cpu. All 35 prior common SPIR-V outputs match their recorded hashes.
dozen.readback_comparison: The byte count and SHA-256 match the preserved stock capture exactly, including refusal and interpreter scratch words. The reference comparison decodes the complete file independently.
dozen.execution: Named Dozen ICD per runtime.sha256, MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE=true, fresh process, XDG_CACHE_HOME under scratch, timeout 175.

kerr_fold.input: Same fixed pupil and same star latitude interval as archived original 1080p cell 396, in the exact spherical limit s=0.
kerr_fold.method: Range jets bound derivatives of longitude after solving latitude implicitly. The winding coefficient and radial and endpoint remainder are enclosed separately through fixed-domain interval quadrature. A second implementation uses high-precision elliptic integrals and smooth radial integration, at 42 and 58 decimal digits.
kerr_fold.conclusion: In the spherical limit for this source and pupil, the conditioned longitude has exactly one stationary point in the signed phase interval for every winding at or above 1025. It is a minimum. At winding 2049 the independent phase 0.000301611502580171 is inside the interval, and the independent slopes at 0 and 2^-11 agree with the prior finite-s enclosures.
kerr_fold.use_for_a_future_bound: On either side of a convex minimum with curvature bounded below by c>0, the squared slope at an image is at least 2*c times the longitude gap to the minimum. After transferring the curvature bound to nonzero separation, this yields an inverse-slope bound using the gap of that star to the caustic at its winding.
kerr_fold.remaining: Enclose the finite-s derivative corrections and obtain longitude gaps usable over the winding tail. The limiting result cannot alone bound the point-source flux or admit either complete frame.

replay: Extract verification.tar.gz into out/dozen-endpoint-unified. Build the named qualification preset with build.py on the source revision. compile-unified.py independently regenerates the shader from the source before this change.

Compile profile.cpp with g++-14 -std=c++2c -O3 -DNDEBUG -DSIRIUS_CONTRACT_MODE=2 -DSIRIUS_HAS_RETAINED_COMPUTE=1 -DSIRIUS_RELEASE_RESOURCE_LOCKED=1 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -Wno-missing-field-initializers -Isrc -Itests. Link libsirius_backend_cpu.a, libsirius_backend.a, libsirius_core.a, libsirius_base.a, -lvulkan -ldl -lrt -pthread. Execute the command from unified.log with its cold environment and run verify.py.

Build critical-fold-enclosure.cpp with g++-14 -std=c++2c -O2 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -frounding-math -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Isrc and link libsirius_base.a. Run its executable and critical-fold-reference.py (mpmath 1.3.0) from the checkout.
